recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work—not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

rechF3X57IlRHJ3dR.Name: Tim James

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Nature Heals, In Tim's View", "body": "Tim James argues that the body is built to self-heal when we reduce stress, clean up at the cellular level and flood it with nutrition. He points to animals and Native American healers learning from sick horses, and says pharmaceutical companies isolate one compound from a plant, which he likens to calling on a single oboe when a whole symphony orchestra is available. Chance adds that people accept long lists of side effects because they have taken authority for truth instead of truth for authority, and both agree that we are not separate from nature but an expression of it."}, {"title": "Tim's Road to the Hippocrates Health Institute", "body": "Tim grew up on a cattle and hay farm in eastern Oregon, played baseball for decades and lived on the standard American diet until, by his late thirties, his energy and clarity were gone and a health crisis on a trip to Peru showed him that his poor health affected everyone he loved. Accompanying his friend Charles to the Hippocrates Health Institute in West Palm Beach, he sat through an internal awareness class and realised it is an inside job: like a farm tractor, the body needs maintenance, yet nobody gave us an owner's manual. He went on to teach juicing and detox classes to over 5,500 people."}, {"title": "Cleansing the Pathway of Elimination First", "body": "Chance asks what order the organs should be cleansed in, since each release sends toxins down the line. Tim's answer is to clear the pathway of elimination first, then move to kidney cleansing and a liver and gallbladder flush, otherwise, he says, released waste recirculates through the liver and drags out detox symptoms. He recommends colon hydrotherapy sessions back to back, points listeners to his Health Hero Show episode with Rebecca Harder, and describes Gut Detox as a gentler option. Chance recalls his own 2017 colon cleanse using bentonite clay and questions why mucoid plaque is dismissed online."}, {"title": "Emotional Detox and Food as a Dope", "body": "Coaching some 600 people, Tim says he kept finding emotional baggage underneath eating habits, and concluded that many of us use food as a dope to push painful feelings back down. He describes Dr Clement at the Hippocrates Health Institute watching rough cowboys break down crying on the massage table once that dope was removed, his own unexpected release by the pool, and a Reiki master who sensed the change in him. Chance connects this to his tuning fork sessions, noting there are always more layers to the onion and that healing ourselves first is the best way to help heal the world."}, {"title": "Chemical Free Body and Everyday Toxins", "body": "Tim traces Chemical Free Body to reading studies on chemicals found in umbilical cord blood, which convinced him, he says, that we are all polluted and accumulate more toxins with age. He flags synthetic carpet, fresh paint, shampoo with sodium lauryl sulfate and toothpaste warning labels, and says most supplements on the market are synthetic or carry fillers like magnesium stearate and silicon dioxide. After years of growing sprouts and wheatgrass in his garage for local clients, he built a line including Gut Detox, Toxin Detox and a hyper absorbable turmeric tincture, urging listeners to vote with their dollars."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Tim James is the founder of Chemical Free Body and host of the Health Hero Show. Join us for an exploration of what we can do to become radically healthy in the face of society's toxic tendencies, as we discuss the origin story of his company, detox and cleansing strategies, the spiritual necessity of healing our bodies, Tim's experiences with the Hippocrates Institute, and much more!
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In the Plus+ Extension we delve into the consciousness expansion that occurs as we clean out our insides, the innate intelligence of the body, increasing synchronicity by elevating our energy, knowing our true power as vessels of source, protection from parasites, the power of sprouts, and revitalizing ourselves with pure air and structured water.
